text:
To remove hanging strips like Command strips, pull the tab slowly straight down and parallel to the wall, stretching it along its length until it releases, rather than pulling it straight out. If it resists, warm the strip with a hairdryer for 20 to 30 seconds, or slide dental floss behind it and saw through the adhesive. This assumes hanging strips; medical or skin adhesives need a different method.

CONFIDENCE: 75
